en: to be dried; to become dry

examples.ko: 이 과일은 햇볕에 건조돼서 오래 먹을 수 있어요.
examples.en: This fruit is dried in the sun, so you can keep it for a long time.

examples.ko: 이 감은 바람이 잘 통해서 천천히 건조돼요.
examples.en: These persimmons dry slowly because the air flows through well.
If you use a dryer, the laundry dries quickly.
This is fruit that was dried in a place without moisture.

examples.ko: 이불이 아직 덜 건조돼서 못 덮겠어요.
examples.en: The blanket isn't dry enough yet, so I can't use it.

examples.ko: 비가 안 와서 땅이 점점 건조되고 있어요.
examples.en: It hasn't rained, so the ground is getting drier and drier.

explain: '건조되다'는 마르는 과정이나 결과를 설명할 때 써요. 공기나 피부의 상태는 보통 '건조하다'를 써서 '공기가 건조해요'라고 하고, 빨래는 일상에서 '마르다'를 더 많이 써요. 일부러 말리는 것은 '건조시키다'라고 해요.

phrases.en: The laundry dried well in the sun, so it feels crisp.
phrases.nuance_ko: 빨래나 식품이 햇볕을 받아 물기가 빠질 때 쓴다.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when laundry or food loses its moisture by being left in the sunlight.
phrases.en_equiv: to be dried in the sun

explain_en: '건조되다' describes the process or result of something drying out. For the state of the air or skin, people usually use '건조하다', as in '공기가 건조해요', and for laundry '마르다' is more common in daily talk. Drying something on purpose is '건조시키다'.

p.n: 건설되다 is for roads, bridges and buildings, not ships.

examples.ko: 시골에서는 밤하늘에 별이 정말 잘 보여요.
examples.en: In the countryside you can see the stars really well in the night sky.

examples.ko: 구름 때문에 오늘은 별이 하나도 안 보여요.
examples.en: Because of the clouds, I can't see a single star today.

examples.ko: 우리는 누워서 별을 보며 소원을 빌었어요.
examples.en: We lay down, looked at the stars and made a wish.
What is the name of that bright star?
The stars were twinkling in the sky last night.
How long would it take to get to the stars?

explain: '별'은 하늘의 별이고, 모양을 말할 때도 '별 모양'이라고 해요. 호텔이나 식당 등급도 '별 다섯 개'처럼 별로 말해요. '별로'(그다지)는 소리가 비슷하지만 다른 부사예요.

phrases.example: 요즘 서울에서 집 구하기는 하늘의 별 따기예요.
phrases.en: picking a star from the sky; extremely hard to do
phrases.nuance_ko: 거의 불가능할 만큼 매우 어려운 일을 말할 때 써요. 일자리, 표, 집 구하기처럼 경쟁이 센 일에 많이 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for something so hard it is almost impossible. It is often said about competitive things like finding a job, tickets or housing.

explain_en: '별' is the star in the sky, and it is also used for the shape, as in '별 모양'. Ratings for hotels and restaurants are also given in stars, like '별 다섯 개'. '별로' (not very) looks similar but is a different adverb.
